description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vizier of Many Faces triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Vizier of Many Faces.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
